summary: Architectural and clinical UX plan for an interactive ICU bedside workstation combining a Philips IntelliVue MX800 Patient Monitor (with integrated iPC PubChem & openFDA pharmacology workbench) and a 4-bay B. Braun SpaceStation housing Perfusor Space, Infusomat Space, and SpaceControl modules with bidirectional PK/PD hemodynamic coupling.
